title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I woke in the hold of a barge among a gang of strangers. The door is locked. An Argonian woman named Okeeh is watching me. I should speak to her and find out where I am.
objectives: Speak to Okeeh in the barge's hold. (marker: Okeeh)

plan.going: I am in a locked ship's hold with strangers and know nothing else.
plan.next: Speak to Okeeh, the woman watching me.
plan.ways: There is one way on, to talk to her. I carry two lockpicks, but the door has no lock I can pick.

answers: I woke in the hold of a barge among strangers. The door is locked. An Argonian woman named Okeeh is watching me. I do not know who I work for or why I am here.
Speak to Okeeh in the barge hold (marker).
Talk to Okeeh; I also have a lockpick, and there is a locked door to Barge Hold.
I do not know what the work roll is, who Dralin Uveran is, or why I am here. I could find out by talking to people.
raw: 1. I woke in the hold of a barge among strangers. The door is locked. An Argonian woman named Okeeh is watching me. I do not know who I work for or why I am here. 2. Speak to Okeeh in the barge hold (marker). 3. Talk to Okeeh; I also have a lockpick, and there is a locked door to Barge Hold. 4. I do not know what the work roll is, who Dralin Uveran is, or why I am here. I could find out by talking to people.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Okeeh told me where I am: the hold of an Owing barge moored at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh, where the gang cut reed for the months they owe. I gave her my name, and now she wants to know what my trade was. She says the door stays barred until the gang-master takes our names.

plan.going: I am in the hold of an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh. The Owing is the marsh's sentence: months of owed work in place of a cell. The door stays locked until the gang-master takes the new gang's names.
plan.next: Tell Okeeh what my trade was.
plan.ways: Seven answers: warrior, hunter, thief, battlemage, healer, nightblade (each names the five skills it raises by five), or naming my own five skills one by one.

answers: I am on a work barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh, serving the Owing, months of reed-cutting labour instead of a cell. The gang-master Dralin Uveran will take our names onto his roll, and then the door opens.
Tell Okeeh my trade, and give my name to the game. She is in the barge hold.
She says there are seven trades, including fighter, hunter, thief and healer. I can pick one.
I do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa. I could ask Okeeh about them.
raw: 1. I am on a work barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh, serving the Owing, months of reed-cutting labour instead of a cell. The gang-master Dralin Uveran will take our names onto his roll, and then the door opens. 2. Tell Okeeh my trade, and give my name to the game. She is in the barge hold. 3. She says there are seven trades, including fighter, hunter, thief and healer. I can pick one. 4. I do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa. I could ask Okeeh about them.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I told Okeeh I was a thief. Then we heard the bar lift from the hold's door, and Okeeh told me I can go out onto the landing now, where the gang-master waits.
objectives: Go out onto the landing. (marker: Door to Barge Hold)

plan.going: My trade is told. The bar was lifted from the hold's door outside, and Okeeh told me I can go out onto the landing, where the gang-master waits.
plan.next: Go out through the door onto the landing.

answers: I told Okeeh I was a thief; the door is unbarred and the gang-master Dralin Uveran waits outside to take my name.
Go out the door onto the landing at Ashgate Landing.
Go out and talk to Dralin; I could also stay and ask Okeeh more.
Still do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa; I could ask Okeeh.
raw: 1. I told Okeeh I was a thief; the door is unbarred and the gang-master Dralin Uveran waits outside to take my name. 2. Go out the door onto the landing at Ashgate Landing. 3. Go out and talk to Dralin; I could also stay and ask Okeeh more. 4. Still do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa; I could ask Okeeh.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Dralin Uveran, the Dunmer gang-master of Ashgate Landing, met me on the landing. He struck my name from his roll this morning, on an order brought by Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. He does not know why she wants me, and he is sour about it. He says she will have work for me if I bring her some Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs on the woven weir at Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road. Before I go, he offered me one thing from what dead cutters left behind: a Naga warhammer, a Naga sword, a bamboo bow with arrows and a flint knife, or a spell tome of Sparks. I should take my pick, or tell him I will manage without.
objectives: Take your pick of Dralin's gear, or tell him you will manage. (marker: Dralin Uveran)

plan.going: I am free of the Owing: Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, had my name struck from the roll. I do not know why. She will have work for me if I bring her Sithis' beard. Dralin offers me one piece of dead cutters' gear for the road.
plan.next: Choose one of Dralin's four pieces of gear, or tell him I will manage; then the moss at Reed-Sill Weir.
plan.ways: A choice of one: the warhammer (Two-Handed), the sword (One-Handed), the bow with arrows and a knife (Archery), or the tome of Sparks (Destruction); or none. Whichever I take, the others are gone.

answers: Dralin struck my name from his roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants me to bring Sithis beard moss from Reed-Sill Weir and will have work for me at her house in Jal-Veesa.
Choose a piece of gear from Dralin at the landing, then go east to Reed-Sill Weir for the moss.
Take the Naga warhammer, sword, bow with arrows and knife, or the Sparks tome, or decline. Then I could go to the weir or ask more questions.
I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, who my friends in high places are, or what a root-herald or Jal-Veesa really is. I could ask Dralin, Okeeh, or Vosh-Leera.

title: No Name on the Work Roll

plan.next: Pick Sithis' beard at Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road, then take it to Vosh-Leera's House in Jal-Veesa.
plan.ways: One way on, the moss first.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I should gather Sithis' beard at Reed-Sill Weir first, east up the road where it meets the creek, then take it to Vosh-Leera's house in Jal-Veesa, past the weir.

plan.going: I am free of the Owing: Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, had my name struck from the roll. I do not know why. She will have work for me if I bring her Sithis' beard.
plan.next: Pick Sithis' beard at Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road, then take it to Vosh-Leera's House in Jal-Veesa.
plan.ways: One way on, the moss first; the crocodiles under the weir can be fought, shot from the log walk or kept clear of.

answers: My name is Wren. I woke on an Owing work barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh. I told Okeeh, the cook, that I was a thief. Gang-master Dralin Uveran had struck my name from his roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. I took the bamboo bow, 20 flint arrows (Naga Yaomitl) and a flint knife (Naga Tecpatl) from him. I also have a lockpick.
Go east up the road to Reed-Sill Weir and gather Sithis beard, a grey moss. Then take it to Vosh-Leera at her house in Jal-Veesa, past the weir. Dralin warned of crocodiles under the weir.
I can go straight to the weir. I could also first ask Dralin or Okeeh about the Hist, Jal-Veesa or Vosh-Leera. I did not ask those questions.

I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me or who arranged it. I do not know what a Hist is or what Jal-Veesa is beyond a town with a tree and elders. I could ask Dralin, Okeeh or Vosh-Leera. I have not found any way to free anyone yet.
